archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO + PRESTIGE CLUB (Deep Obsidian, Court Terracotta / Forest Emerald accents, Volt White text)

hierarchy_rules.labels: font-sans uppercase text-xs tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-bold

entry_surfaces./: mobile-first athletic bacheca hero with active match count banner, quick filters (Tutti, Singolo, Doppio, Mie), floating 'Proponi' FAB and live match feed
entry_surfaces./login: branded tennis club portal header with clay court texture background, quick member credential login form, demo soci switcher for instant testing
entry_surfaces./register: clean membership onboarding card with full name, skill level self-assessment, phone number for match WhatsApp-free coordination, and password creation

layouts_and_navigation.viewport_strategy: Mobile-First (max-w-md mx-auto on desktop with subtle device framing or clean centered container, full width on real mobile viewports)

header.style: Sticky top bar with Tennis Club Crest, quick member avatar, pending candidate badge count notification, and Logout button

bottom_navigation.description: Fixed bottom tab bar for frictionless one-thumb thumb-zone mobile navigation (iOS/Android feel)

bacheca_feed.description: List of available tennis matches with real-time open spots, proposer card, court surface indicator, date & time, level tag, and 1-tap 'Mi candido' trigger
match_card_elements: Status badge: '🟢 Aperta' vs '🔒 Confermata' / 'Posti Esauriti'
Match Type pill: '🎾 Singolo (1 posto)' or '👥 Doppio (3 posti)'
Proposer Member: Name + Avatar + 'Livello Club: Intermedio (3.4 / 4.1)'
Confirmed Players Roster: Circular avatars with empty slot placeholders ('+1 cercasi' / '+3 cercasi')
Notes/Campo: e.g., 'Campo 2 Terra Rossa, porto io le palline nuove'
CTA Button: 'Mi Candido' with dialog trigger or 'Candidatura Inviata' (if user applied) or 'Tua Partita' (if owner)

candidacy_dialog.description: Mi Candido modal popup collecting member phone/contact, preferred hand/level message, and optional note to proposer
fields: Messaggio / Disponibilità (es. 'Posso arrivare 10 min prima, gioco a destra')

propose_match_form.description: Frictionless match creation form with sensible defaults
fields: Tipo Partita: Singolo (1 avversario) vs Doppio (3 giocatori)
Data: Date picker with quick 'Oggi', 'Domani', 'Questo Weekend'
Ora di inizio: Time select (es. 09:00 - 21:00 ad intervalli di 30 min)
Livello consigliato: testo libero o badge rapidi ('Principiante (NC)', 'Intermedio (4.1-4.4)', 'Avanzato (3.1-3.5)', 'Aperto a tutti')
Note/Campo: Note facoltative (es. 'Campo già prenotato', 'Cerco mancino per doppio')

manage_my_matches.description: Owner dashboard for proposer: view applicants per match, quick 'Accetta' / 'Rifiuta' actions, live spot fill counter, auto-close when full

my_applications.description: Player view of own applied matches with clear status chips (In attesa / Accettata / Rifiutata) and proposer contact reveal on acceptance

demo_soci_switcher.description: Quick profile toggle bar at the bottom or login for instant testing of multi-user match proposals and candidacy approvals without retyping logins

hero_court_bg.description: Atmospheric clay tennis court background for club header and auth backdrop

court_texture.description: Tennis court baseline detail for subtle match card banners

avatar_placeholder_player.alt: Socio del Tennis Club in campo

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale-95 on active buttons, glowing border accent on pending matches with action required

accessibility.apca_contrast: All text tokens meet AA standards (4.5:1 minimum on solid dark slate backgrounds)
accessibility.mobile_touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px hit areas on all buttons, tabs, and action cards
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria labels on icon-only buttons (notifications, close dialog, call/contact button)
accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: All motion.div respect reduced motion with immediate fallback

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app in Italian with mobile-first layout (styled like a native club app with smooth tabs and sticky header).
Implement full mock & persistent backend support in FastAPI with seed matches and users so it works seamlessly immediately.

Implement auth session management using lib/session.ts and provide a 1-tap 'Accedi come Socio Demo' switcher on login page and header so anyone testing can switch between Proposer (Marco Rossi) and Applicant (Matteo Bianchi / Giulia Ferrari).

Ensure match spots calculation is exact: 'Singolo' requires 1 extra player (total 2), 'Doppio' requires 3 extra players (total 4). When accepted candidates fill the required slots, the match automatically turns 'Confermata' (Posti esauriti).
Proposer gets a notification badge count on 'Le mie partite' for unreviewed applications, with instant 'Accetta' and 'Rifiuta' buttons.
Candidate gets instant real-time status in 'Le mie candidature' ('In attesa', 'Accettata - Sei in campo! 🎉', 'Rifiutata').
Add filters on Bacheca: 'Tutti', 'Solo Singoli', 'Solo Doppi', 'Solo Aperte', 'Livello'.

Include mandatory data-testid on every interactive element (data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='apply-match-button', data-testid='accept-candidate-btn', data-testid='match-card-item', etc.).
